info.title: Midnight Persona Web API
info.description: Supabase-authenticated Gateway and Web Commerce. Responses contain public account/chat data only. Browser sessions use standard Supabase Google OAuth/Anonymous Auth and refresh. Authenticated routes send Cache-Control: no-store. Protected n8n server delivery never includes bearer tokens. NOWPayments server callbacks use IPN signatures.

post.summary: Receive an authenticated NOWPayments server notification

schema.description: Original provider JSON, max 65536 bytes. Signature covers recursively sorted JSON using HMAC-SHA512. Browser bearer auth is not used here.

402.description: Payment required; select a configured Web provider

403.description: Consent required or unsupported login provider

429.description: Existing account or dialogue limit exceeded

post.description: Verifies signature, order/provider/invoice/payment association and exact stored price. Only full finished payment grants rights. Duplicate and delayed notifications are safe; partial/unconfirmed payments do not grant rights.

Event.description: Append-only persisted event. No events are synthesized merely because a contract type exists; dependent media/reply producers are wired in later integration stages.

entry_mode.description: Server-owned paid reset context only; never accepted from browser requests.

payment_token.description: Existing confirmed fulfillment token; n8n verifies account/chat and consumes once.

QuickRepliesData.description: Actual SQL producers: exactly three configured opening options, or an empty options list; configured follow-up strings after the selected opening response. Values come from character_opening_replies. No generated guesses.

MediaOfferData.description: Commerce producer; query catalog with chat_code for the effective server price. Optional price is decimal text, never client-authoritative. media_kind reserves future extension to video.

FeatureAccess.description: Existing/free feature right; no external checkout. A fast skip remains unfulfilled until the engine commits its scene reset.
